Hunt the Sun Runner'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[October]] [[2002]]''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]'' was released in a bundle with [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine 1|''Star Wars Adventure Magazine'' 1]], which was released in [[October]] [[2002]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages= |isbn=9780439458795 |isbn2= |isbn3= |audiobook=N/A |timeline=[[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]]{{CSWECite|I|151|Cradossk}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series to a year before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. |series=[[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'' (Scholastic)]] |preceded by= |followed by=''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls|The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]'' }} '''''Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner''''' was the first installment of [[Scholastic]]'s [[Star Wars Adventures (Scholastic)|''Star Wars Adventures'']] series. It consisted of a young reader novel and an accompanying game book for use with the story, and was sent out with the [[Star Wars Adventures Magazine Premiere Issue|''Star Wars Adventures Magazine'' Premiere Issue]] in [[October]] [[2002]]. {{Book-stub}}
